source_title: New Open-World Life Sim Game Puts a Unique Twist on the Formula - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Fields of Aaru is an upcoming open-world farming and life sim game on Steam with a distinctive setting: the ancient Egyptian afterlife. While Steam has no shortage of games in the genre, Fields of Aaru could offer a breath of fresh air because its unique world is more than an aesthetic choice and also affects gameplay.
Developer Zymartu Games describes Fields of Aaru as an adventure along the Nile where players can live forever alongside the ancient Egyptian gods. Like most cozy farming sim games , Fields of Aaru also lets players build a home, expand their land, and explore uncharted areas. And in this case, those areas appear to be the pyramids.
Fields of Aaru Teaches You Ancient Crafts
Genre : Open-world, life sim, farming sim, sandbox
A creative twist Fields of Aaru brings to the subgenre of Stardew Valley -like games is its real-life-inspired ancient crafts. Players will need to use ancient technologies to run their farm, a concept many would argue is underused in the life simulation genre. Examples of such skills cited by developer Zymartu Games include "shaping stone, firing clay, and irrigating fields."
Fields of Aaru also features an interesting cast of characters, including several famous figures from ancient Egyptian mythology. Ptah, Hapi, Sekhmet, and Anubis are all part of the roster players can interact with. Making offerings to these gods can grant players new powers, with each god's blessings reflecting their nature. For instance, Sekhmet, the goddess of war, grants players combat and adventure skills. Meanwhile, Hapi, the god of the annual Nile flood, "speeds up crop growth and makes harvests more bountiful."
Find the odd one out before the timer hits zero.

Zymartu Games is run by Marcel and Thu, a husband-and-wife team. The couple has spent over three years working on this upcoming cozy life sim , but they officially announced it in September 2025. Since then, the game has come a long way and looks almost ready to launch. It also has a playable demo available, which is now part of October's Steam Next Fest. Zymartu Games says, "In the demo, you'll be able to explore the early areas along the Nile. Settle into Aaru, meet the villagers, and begin restoring the town."
While Fields of Aaru 's Steam page shows no release window at the time of writing, Zymartu Games' official website lists Q4 2026 as its planned release . Of course, the date is not set in stone and could change during development. Additionally, the developer has confirmed that Fields of Aaru will be a PC-exclusive game at launch, but the team may consider bringing it to more platforms in the future if the game performs well on Valve's storefront.
